bug_semantics: array * int on a lazy ScriptRange repeats the left sequence count times without charging LoopLimit on the outer repetition. When the left operand is empty or a lazy builtin (array.map/filter/reverse/etc.), the inner StepLoop never runs, so an attacker template can drive billions of uncharged iterations even at LoopLimit=1, pinning CPU and GC while ScriptArray * int is already bounded.
flaw_origin: 7d73abb515f942dd71f8797506356bbe6383b3be first added src/Scriban/Runtime/ScriptRange.cs with MultiplyImpl as an unbounded for-i-in-count / foreach-yield loop and switched lazy array builtins onto ScriptRange. That uncharged outer repetition is the sink; later LoopLimit work only charged inner emission (dde661d3) or ScriptArray growth (205ca6a), leaving this path open until 973edd1f.
